title: Diagram Label Set
description: Translatable label metadata for a diagram. Decouples diagram labels from hardcoded SVG <text> so diagrams render in the active language (or show translated captions). One label set per diagram; translations keyed by language. Supports responsibility #8 (diagrams).

diagram_id.description: Stable id matching the diagram registry (e.g. 'aws-vpc-architecture').

render_strategy.description: How localization is achieved for this diagram.

labels.description: Each positioned label and its translations.

label_id.description: Stable id for this label within the diagram.

translations.description: Map of language code -> translated label text.

localized_assets.description: Optional map of language code -> pre-rendered image/SVG URL when render_strategy = translated-asset.
